snippet.title: Warframe | Iceblade of Narin Official Gameplay Trailer - Available Now On All Platforms!
snippet.description:
Witness a preview of the next Warframe update, featuring voiceover from actor Choi Han!

Atop the Yuvan Peak, where the Tenno mastered their Void powers, an icy monolith rises. Use its strength to beat back a new threat: the Entropic Eximus. Master the keen blade of the first female ice-themed Warframe, Narin. Defend and strike deftly with her swift rapier and deadly Abilities. 

Engage in new six-player Glacial Defiance Missions (coming soon) and aid Cephalon Melica as you return to the Zariman once more! 

Instantly add a free Banshee Warframe when you log in after launch for a limited time until October 7. 

►► WHAT IS WARFRAME? 

Join 90M+ registered players in Warframe, a cooperative, free-to-play third-person looter shooter set in a constantly evolving sci-fi universe. For more info, visit https://warframe.com.
